method: DOM, local HTTP and captured provider response fixtures

checks.name: Readable report controls exist for all five export types and both decision positions
Captured investigation shows four correctly labelled bars, matching numbers and collapsed technical records
Live connection completion and comparative AI performance have distinct labels
Investigation downloads a standalone readable HTML report with all inspected options
Evidence export uses the selected Irish benchmark and keeps captured live-session evidence separate
Evidence report includes the selected benchmark, source references and readable investigation
Comparison report preserves baseline, selected value and difference
Offer report and on-screen chart distinguish optional tests, minimum required gain and absent audit
Withdrawn offer report never presents a retained final offer
A switched decision identifies the final offer and its own required-condition results
Changed inputs cannot export a stale human-readable decision
Study export represents a missing cost calculation explicitly
A failed new investigation cannot export the previous successful run
Negative values retain their sign and missing results are never rendered as zero
Untrusted text is escaped in downloaded reports
Switching models also changes the exported benchmark profile
